name: research-materials-ai-boundary-check
title_zh: 研究材料碰 AI 前先过一遍的合规自检清单
tagline_zh: 拿不准手头文献/访谈能不能喂给 AI 或云端？从授权、隐私到留存期限逐项问下来，只基于元数据和合成样例作答。
tagline_en: Unsure if your files can go into AI or cloud? Walks permission, privacy, retention, sharing—metadata and.
desc_en: Help researchers decide what must be checked before using AI, OCR, literature assistants, storage, or cloud services with research materials. Use for permission, privacy, provenance, institutional approval, retention, deletion, sharing, or incident-planning questions. Work from metadata and synthetic examples only; never claim legal or ethical compliance, upload real sensitive data, or replace an
why_zh: 把散落在机构政策里的灰色地带变成可勾选的决策树，每个问题都指向下一步该找谁确认，而不是替你拍板。
why_en: Turns vague institutional grey zones into a checkable decision tree; each answer points to whom to ask next, instead of.
limit_zh: 不替代机构伦理委员会或法律意见；只覆盖研究材料使用 AI/OCR/云服务前的边界判断，不处理已发生泄露的应急响应。
limit_en: Not legal/ethics advice; covers pre-use boundary checks only, not breach response. Needs your institution's policy text to compare against.
title_en: Pre-AI compliance checklist for research materials
